runtime_upgrade_assessment.notes: No runtime upgrade was found necessary from current official integration documentation. Package bridge compatibility must be validated; maturity risk remains for Go, JavaScript and Python.

risks: Log4j appender exact version needs confirmation

B_contextual_stdout_filtered_for_A.reason: Trace IDs enter the shared source observed by A; filtering after emission contaminates A RAW and is post-hoc treatment manipulation

C_collector_filelog_enrichment.reason: A downstream collector cannot recover the actual active TraceId/SpanId if the producer never emitted them; heuristics are not real context correlation

D_remove_B_log_correlation.reason: Technically simple but removes an explicit part of the current treatment and narrows the research construct

E_partial_language_support.reason: Treatment availability would covary with service/language and potentially fault location/type

collector_to_loki.endpoint_note: Collector composes /otlp/v1/logs; use the base /otlp endpoint, not the full path
collector_to_loki.recommended_application_log_source_for_b: OTLP Collector pipeline as the sole B application-log source; stdout/runtime logs may be retained separately as audit-only

recommended_architecture: A — one existing idiomatic logger call fans out to the existing conventional stdout sink and an independent OTel Logs/OTLP sink for B; Collector B exports to Loki B. Remove application stdout from B model-visible ingestion to avoid duplicates.
alternative: If real OTel context cannot be exported independently from stdout in Pino without artificial/duplicate log calls, stop and request an explicit methodological redesign to remove the B log-correlation requirement; do not filter or fabricate.
open_questions: Can the Pino instrumentation produce an OTLP LogRecord with top-level trace context while leaving the conventional stdout record without trace fields?
Which Logrus bridge release is compatible with the current OTel Go 1.46.0 dependency set?
Which Log4j OTel appender release is compatible with Java agent 2.24.0 and the current Log4j2 config?
How should B retain runtime/framework stdout as audit-only without mixing or duplicating application logs?
What flush/shutdown behavior is needed to prevent loss from batched log export?
